control.title: Leadership oversight and management review
control.description: Leadership reviews the security programme at least annually, covering performance, risks, audit results and improvements, and records decisions.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
evidence_hint: Management review minutes with attendees, inputs covered and decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Minutes of a management review held within the last 12 months, with the date
Inputs covered (risks, audit results, incidents, objectives) and decisions or actions are recorded

requirements.title: Independent oversight
requirements.guidance: The board or equivalent oversees internal control independently of management.

requirements.title: Leadership and commitment
requirements.guidance: Top management shows commitment: approves policy and objectives, provides resources, and reviews performance.

requirements.title: Communicating deficiencies
requirements.guidance: Report control deficiencies to those responsible for corrective action in time.

requirements.title: Management review: general
requirements.guidance: Top management reviews the ISMS at planned intervals.

requirements.title: Management review inputs
requirements.guidance: Cover previous actions, changes, performance, feedback, risk results and improvement opportunities.

requirements.title: Management review results
requirements.guidance: Record decisions on improvements and changes to the ISMS.

evidence.title: Leadership oversight and management review: how we do it
